hook: Keep reheating one masterpiece until it towers, then cash it in or hurl its fire at the enemy.
loop: Heat units by position: behind, beside and next to them.
Keep reheating one piece; each Heat Reforges +1/+1, then cools.
Quench it for big stats, or turn the burns on enemies.

growth.line: Each turn, +1/+1 per Heat, cooling by one; extra Reforges multiply it late.

feel.early: Hot bodies that burn themselves a little.
feel.mid: Positioning puzzle: who sits next to the hot piece.
feel.late: Stacked Reforges, or burns flung at the enemy.

stars.why: Quenches the Hottest and reheats its neighbours, so the hot spot moves.
Turns your own burns into the enemy's.
Rewards ringing the masterpiece with Hot neighbours.

card_short.u02: Regrow; Heats itself after any fight it took damage.
card_short.u03: End of Turn: Heat units in front; back row only.
card_short.u04: When played: Quench a unit for +2/+2 per Heat.
card_short.u05: Sell a unit: get an Ingot, once a turn.
card_short.u06: End of Turn: Heat your Hottest other unit.
card_short.u07: Refreshing Heats the units beside it, once a turn.
card_short.u08: End of Turn: your Hot units gain +1/+1.
card_short.u09: Your burns also hit the enemy across, even through Shields.
card_short.u10: End of Turn: Heat every unit next to it.
card_short.u12: Units beside it Reforge once more.
card_short.u13: Gold for empty slots next to Hot units, up to 2.
card_short.u14: Quenches your Hottest each turn, then Heats its neighbours.
card_short.u15: Hot units give enemies across double Heat; they burn instead.
card_short.u16: All your units Reforge once more.
card_short.u18: Your units Regrow Attack too; the fallen gain Heat.
card_short.u19: Hottest Reforges once more per Hot unit next to it.
card_short.x02: Flavour text for Mother Atra and Warden Quench.

builds.name: One Masterpiece
builds.line: Pile Heat on one piece; ring it with Hot neighbours and multipliers.

builds.name: Quench and Reheat
builds.line: Heat fast, Quench for big stats, keep burns low.

builds.name: Scorched Earth
builds.line: Furnace stops cooling; Ember-Slinger or Spitter turns burns on the enemy.

liked: Warden Quench moves the Hottest every turn: a fresh positioning puzzle each recruit.
Ember-Slinger turns the tribe's own burns into the weapon.
worries: Watch: Undying Furnace, Curator and Crater Forge Master stack Reforges; needs late sim.
Watch: Ottilie's Regrow feeds itself; Ember-Slinger halves every enemy across.
changed: Ember-Slinger now says your units keep their Heat and Reforge.
Mother Atra pays only for empty slots next to Hot units.
Reforge cards now say "once more", so stacking reads right.
verdict: Positioning puzzlers reheat one masterpiece each turn, then cash it in or hurl its fire.
